dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Yeah, why do you look so surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: The legend of the God King is part of history, Parvezravan's family affairs are part of history... and so is the mysterious tragedy of the Tanit.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: To put it simply, think about these questions: How do we piece together the fragmented truth?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: What purpose did the record-keeper hold when they wrote down those words? What were they thinking?
